animation.prompt: Create an 8-second single-shot anime greeting from this exact first frame. No cuts, no camera movements, no head turns, no zoom, no large wing motion. No text, no subtitles, no UI, no logos, no extra people, no music. The only audio is the gentle spoken Chinese greeting with a clean recording. Preserve delicate anime linework rather than changing to photorealism.
